points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Validator reports all eight selected packages structurally complete, but main.cpp ignores restart input and solver.cpp:356 always emits zero moment. Structural conformance does not establish usable restart or truthful metadata.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Existing explicit validator passes all eight; it does not detect flat Re200 periodicity, false max-inner statistics, disabled reconstruction, or full mesh held on all ranks.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 metadata periodic contradicts flat t>=200 forces; M2 laminar claims converged while Cd drops20.8% in final65 rows; M015 inviscid final 10% Cd changes15.2%.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd7.226 and Re200 Cd4.853 with no shedding are not credible; low-Mach M015 laminar Cd0.583 is unusually large. Source/run relation remains qualified.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted report PDF has 15 readable pages covering five NACA cases; checkpoint 0b4616f provides extra standalone histories and field images. Re200 late plots show no periodicity and historic source figures are omitted under curation.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Main report covers five cases and marks others incomplete; historic checkpoint has extra standalone plots and final-case summary. Re200 metadata success/inner statistics conflict with unchanged force and residual histories.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Checkpoint metadata changed max iteration count and convergence statistics while residual history remained byte-identical and always reports five iterations; fixed 2024 timestamps, null revision and historical report/result differences weaken provenance.
